native_context: Google Cloud effective IAM and inherited resource authority
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Google Cloud effective IAM and inherited resource authority — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Gather principal/permission/resource, hierarchy, inherited allow/deny and principal-boundary/condition context where applicable. Trace service-account delegation as its own authority path.
controls.controlled_verification: Resolve one specified action on an owned resource using supported read-only analysis. For a service account, distinguish who can obtain/use its identity from what that identity can do, including required intermediate permissions and conditions.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An inherited role name alone is not an effective action proof. Conditional bindings and denials may defeat a path; reachability to an intermediate service account must not be assumed.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Narrow the specific effective binding/delegation and preserve required workload operations. Re-evaluate the original tuple and a legitimate operation under the same hierarchy/context.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
